3112309.findings: Blue and white vitreous enamel sign 'LEADING NEWSPAPER. THE DAILY TELEGRAPH. TASMANIA.' with 'MADE IN ENGLAND' at lower right. This is the Launceston Daily Telegraph, which ceased in 1928, so the sign is pre-1928 local Tasmanian advertising. Genuine enamel construction (rusted iron reverse with white enamel back coat).
3112309.condition: Large enamel loss and rust to top right corner with a jagged edge, chips at fixing holes and edges, reverse heavily rusted. Face otherwise bright and glossy.
3112309.reason: Rare pre-1928 Launceston Daily Telegraph enamel sign, strong Tasmanian advertising collector appeal despite corner loss
